title: Inventory: Ronald et al. 2005 (PLoS Genet 1:e25) supporting information
intro: Generated by `ingest/inventory.py` from `sources/ronald2005/raw/`: every supporting-information file of
Ronald J, Brem RB, Whittle J, Kruglyak L (2005) Local regulatory variation in Saccharomyces cerevisiae,
PLoS Genet 1(2):e25, doi:10.1371/journal.pgen.0010025, fetched from journals.plos.org with plain requests
(`article/file?type=supplementary&id=10.1371/journal.pgen.0010025.<id>`) and saved untouched; PLOS sends no
file name, so each is named by its PLOS id with an extension from its file type. The article page is
`sources/ronald2005/article.html`; quotes used by the ingest are in `extracted/text_facts.tsv`. Checksums are in `MANIFEST.tsv`.

roles.journal.pgen.0010025.sg001.eps: Figure S1. Comparison of linkage and ASE fold-change estimates for the genes not significant for ASE and the 16 controls (figure only, EPS).
roles.journal.pgen.0010025.sg002.eps: Figure S2. Increased divergence across extended regions in genes showing self-linkage (figure only, EPS).
roles.journal.pgen.0010025.sg003.eps: Figure S3. Enrichment for non-coding polymorphism in self-linking genes is not an artifact of overlapping intergenic regions (figure only, EPS).
roles.journal.pgen.0010025.st001.txt: Table S1. Linkage analysis results: one row per tested ORF (5,727), self-linkage flag, log2 fold change BY/RM with 95% bootstrap CI, -ln p, and 1- and 2-LOD support intervals (bp, in the paper's coordinates). Core input.
roles.journal.pgen.0010025.st002.txt: Table S2. ASE results: 77 self-linking genes and 16 controls, linkage and allele-specific-expression fold changes BY/RM with CIs and p-values.
roles.journal.pgen.0010025.st003.doc: Table S3. Comparison of promoter polymorphisms with synonymous polymorphisms at predicted transcription-factor binding sites (Word table; not parsed).

missing: No marker map or genotype data; Table S1's support intervals are in base pairs of the 2005 SGD assembly, which the atlas does not convert (see OPEN_QUESTIONS).
No list of the 2,957 markers or of which marker was tested for each gene.
Expression and genotype data are those of Brem & Kruglyak 2005 (PNAS), not in this bundle.
